tasks.name: Pattern & Anomaly Detection
tasks.details: Apply log analysis techniques to detect recurring patterns, spikes in error frequency, and anomalous events (e.g., audio dropouts, plugin timeouts, memory pressure) across Ableton log corpora.

tasks.name: Error & Crash Diagnosis
tasks.details: Classify and root-cause errors and crashes found in Ableton logs, map them to known error management strategies, and produce actionable remediation guidance.

tasks.name: Reporting & Insights
tasks.details: Aggregate analysis results into dashboards and reports summarizing error trends, top failure modes, and performance insights for stakeholders.

tasks.name: Build log parser for Ableton Log.txt format
tasks.details: Implement a parser that handles Ableton's Log.txt line format, multi-line stack traces, and plugin log sections; output structured records.

tasks.name: Normalize and index log records
tasks.details: Normalize timestamps, severities, and module names; index records for fast querying and correlation across sessions.

tasks.name: Detect recurring error signatures
tasks.details: Cluster and fingerprint recurring error messages and stack traces to identify dominant failure signatures.

tasks.name: Anomaly detection for performance events
tasks.details: Detect anomalous audio dropouts, CPU spikes, and plugin timeouts using statistical thresholds and time-series analysis.

tasks.name: Root-cause crash analysis
tasks.details: Correlate crash dumps with preceding log events to determine root causes and reproduce conditions.

tasks.name: Map errors to management strategies
tasks.details: Build a mapping from error classes to error management strategies (retry, fallback, user guidance, escalation) and document remediation steps.

tasks.name: Build error trend dashboard
tasks.details: Create a dashboard visualizing error frequency trends, top failure modes, and affected modules over time.
